reviewed_by: Claude general-purpose subagent, blind judgment reviewer, post-fix stale re-review batch 4, 2026-08-02

samples_reviewed.question_text: The dot is at 8251 and it moves backward 30 numbers. Starting from 8251, just count back 30 numbers. Which number will the dot land on?
The total is 348 and one part is 130. What is the other part?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The competency explicitly requires 'with and without regrouping', but none of the 9 samples ever borrow: 1333−1230, 3463−60, 4990−330, and 2930−2320 each have every minuend digit at least as large as the corresponding subtrahend digit.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The 'with regrouping' sub-case is entirely absent across all 9 samples and every formatter used (mcq, cloze, read_mcq, error_detect, read_fill_in_blank, true_false), including the 4 extra seeds chosen to probe other rendering paths.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Sentence stems like 'The total is 348 and one part is 130. What is the other part?' and 'Ana says: 4990 − 330 = 5320. Is Ana correct?' use vocabulary and structure appropriate for grade 3 quarter 2.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Formats genuinely vary: mcq, cloze, a number-line read_mcq dot-jump ('The dot is at 8251...'), error_detect, read_fill_in_blank parts-and-total, and true_false all appear across the 9 samples.

competency_alignment.rationale: All sampled variation stays within presentation format and operand magnitude; '4990 − 330' and '2930 − 2320' both subtract without a single borrow, so the with/without-regrouping axis this competency names is never actually varied.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Minuends reach 8251 ('The dot is at 8251...'), close to the 'less than 10 000' ceiling, and other samples span from 2-digit (14−2) to 4-digit (3463−60), covering the stated magnitude range.
